description_expanded: OverviewGULF VIEWS, 2 Bikes, newly designed property - 'Beeby The Sand'The Space BeeBy the Sand – Gulf-View Escape Just 50 Steps to the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 50 Steps to the Beach – Unobstructed Gulf views & direct beach access Gated Community with Private Pool – Exclusive & secure coastal retreat Top-Floor Location (3rd Floor) – Breathtaking 180-degree Gulf views (No elevator) 1 King Master Suite + Custom Twin Bunk – Sleeps up to 4 guests Private Balcony with Alfresco Dining – Enjoy stunning coastal & community views Fully Equipped Kitchen – Everything you need for home-cooked meals 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic trails & nearby Rosemary Beach Community Grill Near Pool – Perfect for casual cookouts Parking for 1 Vehicle – Hassle-free private parking Cable TV + Smart TV & High-Speed Wi-Fi – Stay entertained & connected Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to BeeBy The SandWelcome to BeeBy the Sand!A new gem in the rental market, BeeBy the Sand boasts stunning, unobstructed gulf views and has been professionally designed for ultimate comfort. Located directly across from the pristine dunes of Inlet Beach and just a short walk from downtown Rosemary Beach, this retreat offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience.From the moment you step into BeeBy the Sand, you’ll be captivated by its charm. With sweeping 180-degree views of 30A’s beautiful coastline, stylishly appointed interiors, and beach access just 50 steps away, your vacation will start with excitement and relaxation. The combination of breathtaking ocean vistas, upscale furnishings, and effortless beach access makes BeeBy the Sand one of our top vacation rentals.Upon entering this third-floor haven, you’ll find custom-built twin bunk beds designed with children in mind, creating a whimsical and cozy space for little ones to enjoy.Parents can retreat to the luxurious master suite, featuring a king-sized bed with premium linens, all-new furnishings, a king-sized mattress, and a flat-screen TV. The ensuite bathroom is elegantly designed, perfect for washing off the day’s salt and sand.As you make your way to the living and kitchen area, you’ll be greeted by the stunning aqua blue waters visible through the expansive glass doors. This space invites you to savor your morning coffee on the new deck, enjoy breakfast with the kids, or take a leisurely walk to Rosemary Beach for a delightful dinner.BeeBy the Sand truly offers a memorable stay on 30A!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4)Master Bedroom – King sized bedCommon Space – Twin bunk bedsWe look forward to hosting you at BeeBy the Sand!Show less
